name: Frank Arlen Zalinsky

events.place: Richmond Hospital, Richmond, British Columbia, Canada

notes:
The Polish family Bible left by Frank's father Stephen indicates the date of birth for Frank as July 16, 1918. However, the obituary notice indicates July 15.  I have left the birthdate as July 16.  Iris did not prepare an "actual" obituary, nor was there any funeral service, but there was a gathering of friends at the Thompson Community Centre in Richmond on Jan. 12, 2002.  This document, forwarded to me in January 2003 is filed in the Zielinski book.

-Allan Zelmer
